title: ReqPub baseline bundle
description: One JSON file holding exactly what the fingerprint covers, {label, seq, snapshot}, plus the fingerprint the record captured. Verified by exact bytes and canonical JSON per docs/VERIFY.md sections 3 to 6. Additive-only within formatVersion 1; a breaking change increments formatVersion and both schemas stay published.

product.description: Optional display name of the project at export time. Carries no verification meaning.

label.description: The version label as stored, e.g. 1.0. Covered by the fingerprint.

seq.description: The version sequence as stored. Covered by the fingerprint.

snapshot.description: The stored version snapshot, verbatim. Covered by the fingerprint.

value.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of {label, seq, snapshot}, lowercase hex.

recipe.description: The recipe restated in words, so the file explains its own verification.

practice.description: Present only on a practice record: a rehearsal, never evidence. Absent means evidence. Additive in formatVersion 1; every artifact produced before v2.55 is byte-unchanged.
